title: Daemon crash if base class adds attribute that shadows subclass
body:
In particular, this test case fails:

```
[case testAddAttributeThroughNewBaseClass]
import a

[file a.py]
class C:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.x = 0

[file a.py.2]
from b import B

class C(B):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.x = 0

[file b.py.2]
class B:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.x = 0
```
